svg.title: A browser-based seismic observatory: sources, workspace and reusable results
svg.desc: Four preserved catalogue snapshots feed a browser-based observatory. The large central image is an actual expanded-map screenshot with administrative and tectonic context. Traceable descriptive results can be exported as CSV, JSON, HTML, SVG and ZIP. SQLite WebAssembly runs locally in a browser worker; a separate offline SQLite oracle validates evidence. Source rows are retained with provenance, not merged into independent earthquakes.
svg.metadata: Embedded system PNG SHA-256: 7265405354d7036eabe873576120280cd5f6d27a38c1b1f6f28696004ac46fad; dimensions: 1920x1080. Source silhouettes: repository Natural Earth basemap. No simulated interface or plotted data. Capture origin: actual local preview, not a claim of a production capture. Capture URL (provenance, not a public navigation link): http://127.0.0.1:8787/?figure=4d&lang=en

g.text: Preserved sources / an inspectable browser workspace / reusable descriptive information
Session memory · no database server / Docker
Not required by the web runtime
Source rows may overlap across catalogues; no cross-provider event merging or earthquake forecast.
Context: Natural Earth (public domain) · PB2002: Bird (2003); Ahlenius / Nordpil / csterling (ODC-BY 1.0)
